title: Tiny, cute snow globe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- base -->
  <rect x='30' y='72' width='40' height='14' rx='4' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='30' y='72' width='40' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A97B55'/>
  <!-- globe -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='28' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='28' fill='#B3E5FC' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- globe highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='36' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#E1F5FE' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- snow ground -->
  <path d='M24 58 Q50 50 76 58 L76 72 Q50 68 24 72 Z' fill='#F5F5F5'/>
  <path d='M24 58 Q50 50 76 58 L76 62 Q50 58 24 62 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- snowman -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='4.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='39' r='3.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- snowman hat -->
  <rect x='46.5' y='34' width='7' height='3' rx='1' fill='#4A148C'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='30' width='5' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#4A148C'/>
  <!-- snowman eyes -->
  <circle cx='48.8' cy='38' r='0.7' fill='#311B92'/>
  <circle cx='51.2' cy='38' r='0.7' fill='#311B92'/>
  <!-- carrot nose -->
  <polygon points='50,40 53,40.5 50,41' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <!-- buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='0.6' fill='#311B92'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='49' r='0.6' fill='#311B92'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <line x1='43' y1='46' x2='39' y2='43' stroke='#6D4C41' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='46' x2='61' y2='43' stroke='#6D4C41' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <rect x='47' y='42.5' width='6' height='1.8' rx='0.8' fill='#E53935'/>
  <!-- pine trees -->
  <polygon points='33,58 37,48 41,58' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <polygon points='34,54 37,46 40,54' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <polygon points='59,58 63,48 67,58' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <polygon points='60,54 63,46 66,54' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- snowflakes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='42' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='50' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='28' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='36' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='46' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- base knob -->
  <rect x='44' y='84' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6D4C41'/>
</svg>
